is_anopheles.evidence: The study tests Anopheles gambiae s.s. laboratory strains (VKPER and SKK) (page 2, 'Mosquitoes').

reports_target_markers.evidence: No genotyping of insecticide-resistance markers was performed. The paper only mentions that the VKPER colony was previously selected to fix the kdr gene (page 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele counts/frequencies are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Only long-established laboratory colonies (SKK originating from Liberia in 1989 and VKPER maintained at CREC and Wageningen) were tested; no African field mosquitoes were collected or tested (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research study evaluating the virulence of entomopathogenic fungi on mosquito strains (page 1-2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field mosquito collection dates are reported.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed; no genotyping was conducted in the study.

assessment.summary: This laboratory study compared the susceptibility of insecticide-susceptible (SKK) and pyrethroid-resistant (VKPER) laboratory colonies of Anopheles gambiae s.s. to the entomopathogenic fungi Metarhizium anisopliae and Beauveria bassiana applied to polyester netting. No molecular genotyping was performed and no field-collected mosquitoes were evaluated.
exclusion_reasons: No African field populations tested (only laboratory colonies evaluated)
